user_query: Could you please provide me with the current air quality in New York City and the weather forecast for the next three days? Additionally, I would like to know the historical weather records for the past week in Washington, DC. Also, give me the radiation forecast for the next seven days based on the latitude and longitude of Los Angeles.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the current air quality data for New York City.
Get the weather forecast for the next three days in New York City.
Fetch the historical weather records for the past week in Washington, DC.
Obtain the radiation forecast for the next seven days based on the latitude and longitude of Los Angeles.
